messages:
john_cust: Hey team — getting 403 on POST /v1/generate from our prod app since ~08:12 UTC. Response has request-id req_0a1b2c3d. We used the org-scoped service key from the dashboard. Can someone help repro?

alex_support: sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the minimal curl you used (remove secrets) and the full response body? also which org/project you expect the key to be tied to.

john_cust: curl I used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"hello"}'``` Response: 403, body: `{\n  "error": "access_denied",\n  "message": "org header mismatch",\n  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d"\n}` We expect this key to be for org: org_acme_42. No x-org header set by our reverse proxy.

rachel_se: thanks — common issue: our auth checks both token scope/org and optional X-Org-ID header if present. If your proxy injects a different org header it causes 403. Can you check what headers your proxy is sending? Also does the key start with sk_ or rk_?

john_cust: key is sk_live_XXXX. Proxy is the platform ingress, it does set X-Org-ID based on the tenant header. I can ask infra for logs.

abex_support: (typo) meant alex_support: if you can capture a curl that reproduces including the headers your client sends (replace token with SK_REDACTED) that helps. Also include the x-request-id from our response (we have req_0a1b2c3d).

ben_infra: pulling logs for that request_id now, one sec. Debug-bot: created debug job 8921 for req_0a1b2c3d.

debug-bot: debug bundle 8921 available: https://internal.redwood/debug/8921 (access restricted).

ben_infra: log snippet (sanitized): ```[2026-02-28T08:12:15Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d src=10.1.5.22 auth_token=sk_live_[REDACTED] token_org=org_acme_42 header_x_org=org_partner_77 result=403 reason=org_mismatch```

rachel_se: that log shows the token is for org_acme_42 but the proxy is sending X-Org=org_partner_77 -> our service rejects. Two repro paths: 1) curl without X-Org header (should succeed), 2) curl with X-Org set to wrong org (should return same 403). Can you try both and paste outputs? Example repros: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"hi"}'``` and ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_REDACTED" -H "X-Org-ID: org_partner_77" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"hi"}'```

john_cust: ran both, first returned 200, second returned 403 with same request_id req_0a1b2c3d. So it's definitely header mismatch.

alex_support: great repro, thanks. For next steps: (a) ask your proxy team to stop injecting X-Org-ID for requests that use org-scoped keys, or make it inject the correct org (org_acme_42), (b) if you need a quick workaround we can issue a project-scoped token that ignores header checks, but that requires a short ticket.

rachel_se: we should also check for token vs client-type mixups: if you used a runtime key (rk_) anywhere in server-to-server calls it can behave differently. But here logs show sk_ and token_org matches.

ben_infra: added a short ACL note to the debug bundle 8921 and attached a sanitized request/response pair. If you want us to rotate the key or create a temporary token for testing I can coordinate — what's your preferred timeframe?

john_cust: asap — can we get a temp test token to confirm prod fix? Also want a record for our ticket to ops.

alex_support: created internal ticket #SUP-6019 to provision test token and track fix. ben_infra — please create temp token tied to org_acme_42 and drop in the ticket (don't paste token here).

ben_infra: will do, provisioning now. I added suggested config for the proxy: remove X-Org-ID for requests with Authorization header or set header to token_org. Pushing to ops queue.

john_cust: thanks all — will verify once token ready and update here. :thumbsup:

alex_support: marking this thread for follow-up. If you need us to generate curl reproductions for other endpoints (embeddings/rerank) we can.
